title: Network Outage Detection, Triage and Communication
content:
Network Outage Detection, Triage and Communication

Document ID: SOP_C08_OUTAGE_MANAGEMENT

Category: C08 — Network Coverage & Outages

Department: Network

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Purpose

To define how network outages are detected, classified by severity, and communicated to affected customers.

Scope

Applies to all channels and customer segments unless a specific exception is noted below.

Preconditions

Customer identity verified (registered number and OTP where applicable).

Account is active and not under a fraud, legal, or compliance hold.

Roles & Responsibilities

Required Information

Registered mobile number / account ID.

Nature of the request and any reference numbers already issued.

Relevant transaction or ticket ID, where applicable.

Procedure

NOC detects fault via automated alarms or customer-reported tickets crossing threshold.

Assign severity per the table above and open an incident record.

Dispatch field team / activate failover (e.g., COW, backup backhaul) as applicable.

Publish status to the customer-facing Service Status page within 30 minutes of P1/P2 classification.

Close the incident once service is confirmed restored for 30 continuous minutes; trigger RCA process for all P1 incidents.

Decision Points

If the request falls outside standard criteria, route for manual review before proceeding.

If suspected fraud indicators are present at any step, halt standard processing and route per the Fraud & Security Response SOP.

Exception Handling

Cases outside standard scope require supervisor sign-off before proceeding.

Validation

Confirm the account/system reflects the expected end state before the case is closed, and obtain customer confirmation where applicable.

Escalation

Escalations beyond first-line resolution are logged with a unique ticket reference and routed to the relevant specialist team, with an SLA acknowledgement sent to the customer within 24 hours.

SLA / Timing

First-line resolution target is same working day; escalations to specialist teams carry a 2-3 working day SLA.

Audit Requirements

Every action taken under this SOP must be logged against the account with agent ID, timestamp, and outcome for audit and quality-review purposes.

Related Documents

KB_C08_outage_status_check, TRN_002, RCA process (see RCA_TEMPLATE)
